questions.question_en: What is the difference between a fuse and an MCB?
questions.question_hi: फ्यूज़ और MCB में क्या अंतर है?
correct_points: fuse wire melts and must be replaced
MCB trips and can be switched on again
both protect from overload
both protect from short circuit
MCB is faster and reusable

questions.question_en: Why is earthing needed in house wiring?
questions.question_hi: घर की वायरिंग में अर्थिंग क्यों ज़रूरी है?
correct_points: gives a safe path for leakage current
protects people from electric shock
protects appliances
connected to the metal body of appliances
uses a green or green-yellow wire

questions.question_en: What do you do and which tools do you use before working on a socket?
questions.question_hi: सॉकेट पर काम करने से पहले आप क्या करते हैं और कौन से औज़ार इस्तेमाल करते हैं?
correct_points: switch off the MCB or main switch
check with a tester or multimeter that power is off
use an insulated screwdriver
wear rubber gloves or insulated footwear
tell others or put a "work in progress" sign

questions.question_en: A wire is sparking at a switchboard. What will you do?
questions.question_hi: स्विचबोर्ड पर तार से चिंगारी निकल रही है। आप क्या करेंगे?
correct_points: switch off main supply first
do not touch with bare hands
keep people away
do not use water
find loose connection or damaged wire
repair only after power is off
test before switching on again

questions.question_en: A customer's fan runs slow and the MCB keeps tripping. How will you find the problem?
questions.question_hi: ग्राहक का पंखा धीमा चलता है और MCB बार-बार ट्रिप होता है। आप समस्या कैसे ढूँढेंगे?
correct_points: check for overload
check the fan capacitor
check wiring for short circuit or loose connection
use a multimeter or insulation tester
unplug appliances one by one
check the MCB rating

safety.description: each answer gets safety_marks from 0 to 2, 5 answers = 10
